name: Wolverine World Wide
outlook:
What Wolverine World Wide says to expect

  • Full year 2026: gross marginGross margin to be approximately 48.7%, up 140 basis points compared to 2025, including an approximate 170 basis point benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds. This compares to the previous outlook for gross margin of approximately 46.9%.
  • Full year 2026: effective tax rateEffective tax rate to be approximately 19.0%. This compares to the previous outlook for effective tax rate of approximately 18.0%.
  • Full year 2026: diluted sharesDiluted weighted average shares of approximately 82.5 million. This compares to the previous outlook for diluted weighted average shares of approximately 82.0 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 12, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
